title: Nine Yards of Lace
subtitle: 婚礼与新人 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 婚礼与新人（生活与学习·家庭与社区）
meta: 主题语境：婚礼与新人（生活与学习·家庭与社区）　|　核心词汇：bride　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bride 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to dress ① a bride she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② bride, meaning the woman and not the dress, was nine yards of lace and was helped by whoever came last; a bride, she said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bride in that album had the same veil, and the ④ bride at the front, meaning the one the photographer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever dressed properly. A bride, my grandmother said, is nine parts lace and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the lace is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bride was the whole of the wedding, meaning the day she carried and not the woman. The ⑥ bride, meaning the wedding and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody greets and nobody questions; a bride, he said, is either someone you dress or the only word that means both a woman and a wedding. She said the wedding is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ bride had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the lace. The ⑧ bride of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine yards of lace and eleven years of dressing; a bride, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bride I remember is the one at the front, which was photographed in 1972 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bride, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being remembered; every bride, she said, is a wedding that has agreed to look like a woman. She said the wedding was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 新娘（指那个人本身，与婚纱相对）
C. 固定搭配：dress a bride 为新娘穿衣打扮
D. n. 新娘（指相册里每一位）
E. n. 新娘（指前面那一位）
F. n. 新娘（抽象：她所承载的那场婚礼）
G. n. 那场婚礼（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bride she could not name
The bride, meaning the woman and not the dress
bride was the whole of the wedding
the bride had become a photograph in a report
The bride of the whole thing
A bride, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: dress a bride 意为“为新娘穿衣打扮”，1949 年母亲被派去为一位她说不出名字的新娘打扮。
bride 意为“新娘”，指那个人本身而不是婚纱，用了九码蕾丝，由最后走的人帮着穿。
bride 指相册里每一位新娘，每一位都是同样的头纱。
bride 指前面那一位（摄影师留的那一位），是唯一有人认真打扮过的。
bride 意为“新娘”，抽象指她所承载的那场婚礼，父亲说 bride 就是那场婚礼的全部。
bride 为抽象用法，指那场婚礼本身，是一家人里人人都道贺、却没人质疑的东西。
bride 意为“新娘”，到 1967 年这位 bride 成了报告里的一张照片。
bride 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九码蕾丝和十一年的打扮。
bride 意为“新娘”，我记得的是前面那一位，1972 年被拍下，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bride 为抽象总称，祖母说新娘是唯一会因为被记住而变好的。
